steps.name: Resolve configuration snapshot
terminal_outcomes: A resolved configuration snapshot is produced for the service runtime.
Invalid configuration is rejected during startup and the service does not enter a healthy running state.
steps.trigger: Service startup triggers resolution of a per-service environment-backed settings snapshot.

steps.name: Emit schedule tick (calendar polling cadence)
terminal_outcomes: A ScheduleTick is emitted for the polling cycle.
A scheduler stall raises a health alert and polling pauses.
steps.trigger: A running service runtime with resolved config starts the scheduler cadence for calendar polling.

steps.name: Poll calendar source(s)
terminal_outcomes: Raw calendar data is fetched for normalization.
Persistent fetch failure emits an ingest error and the polling cycle is skipped.
steps.trigger: Each ScheduleTick from S02 starts a calendar-source polling cycle.

steps.name: Normalize raw calendar entries
terminal_outcomes: CalendarEvent records are produced with normalized UTC context and dedup keys.
Malformed rows are rejected while valid rows continue through normalization.
steps.trigger: Arrival of raw calendar rows from S03 starts normalization into canonical calendar events.

steps.name: Persist calendar events (append-only)
terminal_outcomes: Calendar events are persisted to the event stream and downstream durable artifacts.
Persistent publish failure halts the calendar pipeline.
steps.trigger: Normalized CalendarEvent records from S04 trigger append-only persistence to the event stream.

steps.name: Build anticipation triggers from calendar
terminal_outcomes: CalendarTrigger and ActiveCalendarSignal outputs are produced.
Duplicate or expired trigger candidates fall back to conservative suppression metadata.
steps.trigger: Calendar events and the current ScheduleTick trigger anticipation-window construction.

steps.name: Ingest market ticks
terminal_outcomes: A normalized MarketTick is emitted.
Malformed ticks are skipped with ingest-error handling.
steps.trigger: Availability of the broker price feed starts market tick ingestion.

steps.name: Aggregate ticks into bars
terminal_outcomes: A Bar output is produced for the configured timeframe.
Out-of-order ticks are dropped according to the aggregation policy.
steps.trigger: Incoming MarketTick records from S07 trigger bar aggregation.

steps.name: Compute indicators
terminal_outcomes: An IndicatorSnapshot is produced.
Indicator computation errors emit an error condition instead of an accepted snapshot unless explicitly flagged.
steps.trigger: Completed Bar data from S08 triggers indicator computation.

steps.name: Assemble strategy feature frame
terminal_outcomes: A FeatureFrame is assembled for downstream signal evaluation.
Missing required features raise a packaging error and no FeatureFrame is emitted.
steps.trigger: IndicatorSnapshot plus CalendarTrigger context triggers feature-frame assembly.

steps.name: Generate signal (or suppression)
terminal_outcomes: A Signal is emitted for downstream intent construction.
A SignalSuppressed outcome is emitted when deterministic suppression or internal error conditions apply.
steps.trigger: A complete FeatureFrame triggers signal evaluation by the signal engine.

steps.name: Convert signal to trade intent
terminal_outcomes: A TradeIntent is produced for risk evaluation.
Invalid conversion emits an error outcome and no TradeIntent is accepted.
steps.trigger: An approved Signal from S11 triggers trade-intent construction.

steps.name: Evaluate risk and size
terminal_outcomes: A RiskDecision is produced for downstream order compilation.
Failed risk checks reject the candidate and halt the path for that signal.
steps.trigger: TradeIntent arrival from S12 triggers risk evaluation and sizing.

steps.name: Compile order intent
terminal_outcomes: An OrderIntent is compiled for broker routing.
Compilation failure stops the path before broker routing.
steps.trigger: A RiskDecision from S13 triggers compilation of an OrderIntent.

steps.name: Route order to broker
terminal_outcomes: A RoutedOrderIntent is created for transport delivery.
Routing failure rejects the handoff before transport.
steps.trigger: A compiled OrderIntent triggers broker-routing preparation.

steps.name: Serialize and send to MT4 adapter
terminal_outcomes: A BrokerOrderEnvelope is serialized and delivered to the selected transport path.
file_seq and checksum_sha256 are generated for the delivered artifact.
Transport failure stops or degrades the delivery path for that decision.
steps.trigger: A RoutedOrderIntent from S15 triggers MT4 transport serialization and delivery.

steps.name: EA executes broker order
terminal_outcomes: A BrokerExecEvent is produced from broker execution.
EAHealth output is produced alongside execution-state handling.
steps.trigger: Arrival of a broker-order envelope at the MT4 runtime triggers EA-side execution.

steps.name: Normalize broker events to canonical reports
terminal_outcomes: An ExecutionReport is created for downstream OMS application.
A PositionSnapshot is created alongside the normalized execution report.
Execution-completed publication is emitted for downstream consumers.
steps.trigger: Broker execution results from S17 trigger normalization into canonical execution reports.

steps.name: Apply execution reports to OMS state
terminal_outcomes: OrderStateChanged is produced for OMS progression.
PositionStateChanged is produced for OMS progression.
TradeClosedRaw is emitted when closure is detected.
steps.trigger: ExecutionReport application begins when normalized execution results arrive from S18.

steps.name: Classify trade close and compute canonical PnL
terminal_outcomes: A TradeClosed record is produced with canonical close classification.
Close-classification processing completes or halts on computation failure.
steps.trigger: TradeClosedRaw output from S19 triggers close classification and canonical PnL computation.

steps.name: Bucketize outcome
terminal_outcomes: An OutcomeBucket is produced for downstream reentry logic.
The close result is mapped into the approved outcome vocabulary.
steps.trigger: A classified TradeClosed record from S20 triggers outcome bucketization.

steps.name: Compute event proximity
terminal_outcomes: An EventProximity output is produced for matrix lookup.
steps.trigger: Trade-close context and calendar timing data trigger event-proximity evaluation.

steps.name: Lookup matrix decision
terminal_outcomes: A MatrixDecision is produced with resolved tier and parameter references.
Matrix lookup failure halts the request for that reentry evaluation.
steps.trigger: Outcome and proximity context trigger parameter-set resolution in the reentry matrix.

steps.name: Build reentry trade intent (or suppress)
terminal_outcomes: A reentry decision is built with hybrid_id and chain_position.
Reentry suppression is produced when chain limits or eligibility checks prevent a new reentry trade intent.
steps.trigger: A MatrixDecision and current chain state trigger reentry-decision composition.

steps.name: Loop: reentry intent follows same risk->order->route->transport->execute chain
terminal_outcomes: A new reentry execution pass would forward into the downstream risk and order chain if the loop path existed.
Without a confirmed downstream consumer, the loop remains unimplemented and the artifact is left without execution handoff.
steps.trigger: A reentry decision from S24 triggers the attempted handoff back into the execution chain.

steps.name: Health aggregation + SLO evaluation
terminal_outcomes: Health metrics and health-report outputs are emitted.
Alerting and risk-off escalation occur when health is unknown or degraded.
steps.trigger: Available service-health and monitoring inputs trigger health aggregation and SLO evaluation.
